adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Women may carry a ceremonial Spanish cane or broadcloth blankets
movement_profile.footwork: Steps inspired by the movements of turkeys
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Starts as a circle (formerly around a pole), moves to a central cluster around drummers
movement_profile.partnering: Women choose male partners during the final phase

signature_moves.description: Dance movements inspired by the gait and behavior of turkeys
signature_moves.name: Turkey Mimicry

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not continue dancing after sunset; do not perform without the appropriate historical songs

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is defined by male voices singing 52 traditional songs in Caddo dialects, accompanied by rhythmic drumming. The songs transition from creation myths to specific military histories.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chanted or sung in Caddo dialects; narrative and historical

basic_steps: Women form a circle around the central area
Move in a circular path using steps inspired by turkey movements
Cluster toward the center around the drummers during the third phase
Select a male partner for the final phase
teaching.formation: Circular, transitioning to a central cluster
teaching.level_notes: The dance is performed by women of the community; men participate as singers, drummers, and eventually as invited partners.
